payload.title: Reader island controls: stars and thumbs over one scale; per-site control setting; icon + text, no colour alone
payload.description:
Repo: **Papyrus**. Files: `src/papyrus_content/projection/plugin_assets/papyrus-reader.js` (the vote/rating islands; find `up`, `value`, `net`), its island settings (`IslandSettings`, `blocks.py` `_island_html`), the island CSS next to it, `features/reader-subject-votes-island.feature`, the islands' JS tests (find with `grep -rln "papyrus-reader" features scripts`), `docs/reader-steering.md` (control settings).

## Change
Two controls over the one stored scale, chosen per surface by the site:
- **Thumbs** (`control: "thumbs"`, the default so Shipped is unchanged in look): two buttons, Lucide `thumbs-up` and `thumbs-down`, pressed state as icon fill + text ("You voted up"), never colour alone. Up sends `value: 1` (stored 5), down `value: -1` (stored 1), again removes (`null`). Shows "82% up" from `upShare` and the count, e.g. "82% up · 31".
- **Stars** (`control: "stars"`): five Lucide `star` buttons; a pick sends `stars: k`; the same pick again removes. Shows "4.2 ★ from 31" from `mean` and `n`. Hover/pick state is fill + aria-pressed + text, not colour.
- Both read the reader's own state from the reader-state response (`votes[subject].up` 1-5, `thumb`) and the public numbers from the `{mean, n, hist, upShare}` block (snapshot story). No borders; rounded flat tones; works keyboard-only; without JavaScript the static numbers still render.
- Config: `projection.json` `reader.controls: {item: "thumbs" | "stars", reference: "stars", proposal: "thumbs", story: "thumbs"}`; per site, default thumbs. Ryan's open question (one overall star beside Shipped's dimensions) is answered by this setting: Shipped may set `item: "stars"` later; the dimension ratings are not touched.

## Gherkin (features/reader-subject-votes-island.feature)
  Scenario: A thumbs up is sent as one and shown as the share of up judgements
  Scenario: A reader picks four stars and the card shows the mean and count
  Scenario: Picking the same star again removes the judgement
  Scenario: The pressed state is readable without colour and by keyboard
  Scenario: A site chooses stars for References and thumbs for items
  Scenario: Without JavaScript the numbers still show

## Acceptance
Front-end cucumber + JS tests pass; local dev-server review of a Reference grid with stars and an item with thumbs (screenshots on the story). Blocked by the snapshot story for the public shape; the control markup and settings can start now against the shape in this epic.
